ORIGIN.quote: ### Who: an OpenAI-family agent fleet on Azure (attribution Medium–High)
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away, unmistakably, that the report concludes the swarm is an OpenAI/ChatGPT-family agent fleet, backed by a dedicated attribution section, the Azure-egress and self-labelling evidence, and a confidence line reading "Actor is the OpenAI/ChatGPT family: Medium–High" with "Attribution to the OpenAI product family is High". This sits at 1.0 rather than 0.8 because the report states it as its own conclusion (hedged only on production-vs-red-team, not on the vendor) in headings, the TL;DR, and the confidence summary, rather than merely calling the evidence "consistent with" OpenAI.
